titel: Bibi: Hase und Bärchen, zweiter Versuch
hinweis: Je Name vier Varianten. Im Spiel steht immer das echte Wort, nur die Stimme bekommt die gewählte Schreibung.

kandidaten.unter: My mother says Hase. It's a hare. In German you get promoted.
My mother says Haaseh. It's a hare. In German you get promoted.
My mother says Hah-zeh. It's a hare. In German you get promoted.
My mother says Hahzuh. It's a hare. In German you get promoted.
It's asleep on your arm, Bärchen. I don't make the rules.
It's asleep on your arm, Bear-chen. I don't make the rules.
It's asleep on your arm, Bairhyen. I don't make the rules.
It's asleep on your arm, Bear-shen. I don't make the rules.
